dispatchContext.memoryText:
- Project-life bookkeeping commits run only on main. PM writes to .agents/PROGRESS.md and .agents/CHANGELOG.md are guarded; PM guidance points to .agents/decisions/ and .agents/plans/.
- Section placement resolves environments by folder path. When the same folder belongs to an ancestor section and its descendant, bind the chat to the ancestor section. Explicit `thread_places` assignments take precedence. A single matching section keeps existing behavior; sibling sections sharing a folder remain unbound, and a project-root match remains unbound. Apply the shared resolution rule consistently in list bindings, `naturalPlace`, and `locate`.
- Execution defaults can pin a chat environment as `folder` or `worktree`. Resolve the pin nearest-first across section, ancestors, project, and global settings. A `worktree` pin preselects a managed worktree on the folder host in both New chat and the composer chip; spawn must preserve that managed-worktree selection. With no pin, keep the existing folder/section-provider behavior. Groups must never become chat environments.
